EXPERIMENT ID: ACTIVE
// UNIFIED PROTOCOL BUS
Native direct integration with ATProto, ActivityPub, and Nostr. Transmit across all networks concurrently with protocol-specific character limits, thread splitting, and automated mention/link facets.
// MEDIA AIRLOCK PIPELINE
Drop media to pre-stage immediately. Computes SHA-256 hashes and BlurHash placeholders locally, pre-uploading directly to native protocol endpoints with zero third-party cloud bandwidth fees.
// SQLITE WAL DURABILITY
Scheduled transmissions and outbox receipts survive machine reboots. Embedded SQLite WAL engine executes automated exponential backoff across 5 retry attempts on transient network failures.
